description: Code-behind for StartExam.aspx page handling exam selection, course loading based on user semester, and exam initiation logic in an online examination system.

classes.name: StartExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for StartExam.aspx managing exam start process, course list population based on user semester, and exam attempt validation.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles page load event; loads course list based on user semester stored in session.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Empty event handler for select button.

methods.name: startB_Click
methods.description: Initiates exam based on selected exam type (Theory or MCQ), checks question availability, and sets session variables.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out user and redirects to login page.

methods.name: GridView1_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Checks if student already taken the selected theory exam; if not, prepares to start the exam.

methods.name: GridView2_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Checks if student already taken the selected MCQ exam; if not, prepares to start the exam.
